style_lock: Cohesive game art direction concept sheet for 'GridFall', a stylized isometric 3D sci-fi city crisis simulation in Godot 4.7. Clean geometric low-poly architectural forms with chamfered edges, matte dark basalt slate (#131722) and brushed titanium (#D6DFEB) surfaces, accented by sharp emissive neon strips in electric cyan (#00F0FF), solar amber (#FFB800), relay violet (#B44CFF), bio emerald (#10E88A), and blackout crimson (#FF2E54). Crisp studio concept art presentation on a dark blueprint grid background, high contrast, no watermarks, sharp clean edges.
